name: dsh-theme-admech
description: Pure Forge-Cathedral tech-gothic theme for DSH. v0.9.0: themed macOS application icon (Dock/Finder install + restore scripts), readable recommendation badge in agent question cards, and a fix that keeps the composer primary button Mars-red in queue/steer/stop states. v0.8.0: one-piece boot prelude takeover, machine-spirit telemetry rail (speed / cache hit / context), reasoning-effort slider plus a cogitation-depth gauge inside the composer. v0.7.18 prevents the modal dialog frame from breaking composer popovers. v0.7.17 fixes the black embedded Usage page on Windows. v0.7.0: Windows 11 verification pass. v0.6.x: deliverable cards, Windows Platform view, icon fixes. v0.5.x: startup splash, process icons, composer removeChild fix. v0.4.2 icon restoration. macOS + Windows verified. 机械神教 · 铸炉圣殿。
